prompts.homepage:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished high-fidelity Lithuanian beauty booking web product for madbeauty.lt. A single tall complete desktop page in one image, desired 1536 x 3840 portrait canvas (or closest tall high-resolution supported canvas). This is a private visual concept showing the eventual booking platform, not a screenshot of existing software. Full straight-on flat website image with no device frame, no perspective mockup, no surrounding presentation board, no multiple pages side by side. Include the whole page from navigation to bottom, consistent alignment, comfortable readable UI text, exceptional photography, intentional typography and varied composition. Brand: lowercase refined wordmark "madbeauty." in dark ink, porcelain-white #FAFAF7 background, near-black green #18211D text, coral #F4664A principal action, restrained pale sage #E8F1EA accents. Beautiful editorial serif display headlines paired with precise modern sans-serif labels and body; Lithuanian diacritics. Elegant photographic beauty art direction, contemporary magazine quality with useful product UI, not generic SaaS template. Subtle line dividers, restrained 12px corner radii for functional cards, ample purposeful whitespace. Realistic fine skin texture, correctly formed hands and nails, distinct photo crops and lighting across images, candid specialists rather than identical stock photos. No purple gradients, no glassmorphism, no repeated icon/heading/paragraph grids, no fake awards or star-review numbers, no oversized dashboard KPIs. Names, prices, portfolio and appointments are illustrative mock data only. Small quiet top label "Dizaino maketas"; no ImageGen badge or photo watermark. The shared brand should look consistent across homepage, public specialist profile and professional workspace, with each composition distinct.
Asset type: HOMEPAGE, full long public website.
Section sequence top-to-bottom:
1. Compact header with madbeauty. wordmark left, readable navigation "Paslaugos", "Meistrai", "Gidai", and actions "Meistrams", "Prisijungti". Slim demo label.
2. An authored editorial first screen, not the usual two-column SaaS split hero. Large headline exactly "Tavo laikas. Tavo grožis." with a short sentence "Rask meistrą ir laiką, kuris tinka tau." A prominent full-width single cohesive search control with four clearly labeled fields: "Paslauga" chosen "Gelinis lakavimas", "Miestas" chosen "Vilnius", "Data" chosen "Rytoj", "Laikas" chosen "17:00–20:00", coral button "Rasti laisvą laiką". Small useful helper "Visas vizitas turi tilpti pasirinktame laike."
Below or closely integrated with search, a beautifully composed wide photographic ribbon: precise editorial hands with short elegant natural glossy manicure, a genuine-looking manicure work setting, and one candid female specialist at work. Photo cropping is dynamic without obscuring text or search. No generic fashion model unrelated to procedure.
3. Asymmetric category editorial strip with distinct photos and concise labels "Nagai", "Plaukai", "Antakiai", "Masažai"; nail care emphasized. These future categories are a visual roadmap only. Different scale and image rhythm from hero.
4. Useful section heading "Laisvas laikas tau". Three carefully designed specialist booking cards in one horizontal row, with small distinct natural portraits or studio thumbnails, names "Austėja", "Gabija", "Ieva", Vilnius district examples without exact addresses; illustrative clear service price "35 €", "40 €", "38 €", duration "90 min.", and coral outlined available time choices "17:00", "17:30", "18:00". Quiet small label "Demonstraciniai profiliai". No fabricated review stars or testimonials.
5. A simple typography-led explanation of choosing service, selecting available time, confirming visit. Not three repetitive icon cards; use a clean horizontal journey with real UI fragments and varied spacing.
6. A wide pale sage professional invitation panel with candid working-specialist photo, strong headline "Tavo darbas. Daugiau matomumo.", text "Pradėk nuo nemokamo profilio.", and coral "Prisijungti meistrams" button. Brand visual is calm and useful, no earnings promises.
7. Magazine-style guide section "Prieš vizitą" with three beautiful distinct editorial photo article thumbnails, short titles "Kaip pasirinkti manikiūrą", "Kas įeina į paslaugos kainą", "Kaip pasiruošti vizitui". Vary image proportions slightly with clean grid.
8. Complete dark-ink footer with readable logo, "Apie mus", "Kontaktai", "Privatumas", "Naudojimosi sąlygos", "Meistrams", "MB Pinet", "info@pinet.lt", and small exact sentence "Mūsų verslas automatizuotas su verslomatika.lt".
Design the FULL page with all sections visible, no cut-off footer. Sharp legible Lithuanian labels, real photography already integrated in the UI, confident alignment.

Same brand and header as homepage; page is an information-rich beautiful profile with usable booking rail, not another homepage.
1. Header with wordmark and navigation; breadcrumbs "Pradžia / Nagai / Vilnius / Austėja".
2. An elegant asymmetric photographic gallery band across page width: warm bright real-looking manicure studio, close-up deep burgundy short manicure, close-up translucent nude manicure, candid fictional female professional. No copied brand logos, no fake exact address. Varied crops, photorealistic authentic materials.
3. Profile identity "Austėja — nagų meistrė", district "Vilnius · Naujamiestis", simple contact icon controls, quiet "Demonstracinis profilis", optional "Išsaugoti". Beautiful avatar matched to studio persona. No fake stars, reviews or professional certifications.
4. Strong practical main two-column content: left broader service list titled "Paslaugos" with tabs "Manikiūras", "Pedikiūras". Rows: "Gelinis lakavimas" — "90 min." — "35 €"; "Manikiūras be lakavimo" — "45 min." — "25 €"; "Pedikiūras su lakavimu" — "90 min." — "45 €". Below selected service, optional add-on row "Seno lako nuėmimas" with "15 min. · 5 €". Price and duration examples only.
Right booking sidebar on light sage: heading "Pasirink laiką", compact month/date picker with date chips including "Šiandien", "Rytoj"; chosen tomorrow; time choices "17:00", "17:30", "18:00" with one selected. Summary "Gelinis lakavimas", "90 min.", "35 €", chosen start/end "17:00–18:30", coral button "Rezervuoti laiką". Visible small "Demonstraciniai laikai". Crisp usable spacing.
5. A substantial portfolio section "Darbų galerija" with SIX varied photographic manicure tiles: short nude nails, deep burgundy, French tips, coral, minimalist fine nail art, natural manicure. Realistic hands with correct anatomy, varied skin tones and angles, no repetitive identical hand. No overlays claiming real customer work.
6. "Apie meistrę" concise demonstration text, studio detail photo, and "Vieta" tasteful clean static locator sketch / address area showing only "Naujamiestis, Vilnius", no invented street number or brand map watermark.
7. Compact practical "Prieš vizitą" and "Atšaukimo sąlygos" accordion-style rows, photo-free clean layout.
8. Full footer matching homepage with legal/operator contact "MB Pinet", "info@pinet.lt", "Mūsų verslas automatizuotas su verslomatika.lt".
All page sections visible through footer. Clear profile/booking hierarchy. Do not invent testimonials/reviews. Distinct composition from homepage, same signature brand.

Asset type: PRIVATE PROFESSIONAL WORKSPACE, full tall dashboard page for the specialist, not a customer profile or marketing landing.
A functional impressive app canvas with persistent slim LEFT sidebar and broad central work area, generous page length showing calendar then lower operational sections, no unnecessary marketing hero photos.
1. Sidebar dark ink with refined madbeauty. wordmark and sharp consistent line icons, navigation "Apžvalga", "Kalendorius" selected, "Užklausos", "Klientai", "Paslaugos", "Mano profilis", "Nustatymai"; bottom mini fictional specialist avatar "Austėja" and "Pagalba". Main canvas porcelain white, pale sage calendar structure, coral primary actions. No rainbow analytics.
2. Top workspace utility bar with "Mano darbo vieta", compact profile menu, notification control, and quiet "Dizaino maketas · Demonstraciniai duomenys".
3. Greeting and actionable headline "Tavo savaitė, Austėja." modest normal headline. One compact horizontal factual demo summary "4 vizitai šiandien", "2 naujos užklausos", not giant vanity statistic boxes. Coral "Naujas vizitas" and secondary "Peržiūrėti profilį".
4. The main centerpiece: a LARGE readable weekly appointment calendar with weekday columns "Pirm.", "Antr.", "Treč.", "Ketv.", "Penkt.", "Šešt." and time gutter 09:00 through 20:00. Calendar takes most width, clean subtle 30/60 minute divisions; well-placed nonoverlapping appointment blocks showing short fictional first names and service names, differentiated gentle sage/peach tones, clean open intervals. A subtle current-time indicator. Toolbar "Ši savaitė", previous/next arrows, "Diena", "Savaitė", toggle. Selected demonstration appointment right-side detail rail headed "Vizitas": "Gabija", "Gelinis lakavimas", "17:00–18:30", "35 €", status "Patvirtinta", practical buttons "Keisti laiką" and "Atšaukti". No real email/phone/client health fields. Make the calendar crisp and attractive, genuinely readable not a vague abstract heatmap.
5. Below calendar, compact operational list "Naujos užklausos" with TWO illustrative rows, service and date/time preference, concise "Atsakyti" actions. Neighbor section "Laukiančiųjų sąrašas" with TWO sample preferences and "Pasiūlyti laiką". Not chatty fake AI messages.
6. "Paslaugos ir grafikas" useful short service table (name, duration, price, edit) and clean weekly hours control. Realistic UI labels "Gelinis lakavimas", "90 min.", "35 €"; "Seno lako nuėmimas", "15 min.", "5 €". Blank/open calendar state visibly understandable.
7. "Tavo viešas profilis" lower compact preview row with fictional avatar and THREE beautiful manicure portfolio thumbnails, action "Redaguoti profilį", "Pridėti nuotraukų"; no giant additional hero.
8. Clean settings tail: "Pranešimai", email channel toggle, "Duomenų eksportas", small help/contact "info@pinet.lt". No paid-plan upsell and no fake revenue chart.
Full tall dashboard composition from top to bottom, same platform brand as public pages but dense professional Operate mode. Original photographs limited to avatar and profile preview; utility dominates. No cropped bottom.
